title: Minecraft
description: Sandbox videogame built out of blocks, developed by Markus "Notch" Persson at Mojang. Notch started development on 2009-05-10 and publicly released the first version on 2009-05-17 as "Cave Game", sold as an early-access alpha and later beta while it was already becoming an internet phenomenon; the "complete" 1.0 release arrived on 2011-11-18 at MINECON 2011. Players explore a randomly generated world, mine and place blocks, craft items and build, in survival or creative mode. It became the best-selling videogame of all time and spawned a large mod, server and video ecosystem. Update 1.12 on 2017-06-07 added parrots, tameable mobs that dance when a jukebox nearby plays music (a reference to the Party Parrot meme); that mechanic led to the video 2019/wholesome_parrots_dancing.
